title: 剑龙背上的板
subtitle: 散热，还是吓唬人
character: wearing a sage green t-shirt, brown shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft watercolour washes with fine pencil outlines and visible paper grain, sage green, warm ochre and dusty rose

pages.zh:
博物馆里有一只恐龙，
背上竖着一排板，
像一把一把
插在背上的扇子。
爸爸说，它叫剑龙。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up in a museum, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, his mouth open in surprise; behind him rises the back of a stegosaurus skeleton with a row of tall flat plates.

pages.zh:
最大的一块板，
比我的脸还大。
一共十七块，
沿着背脊
一路排到尾巴根。

奇怪的是，
这些板
并不长在脊椎上。
它们埋在皮里，
像插在土里的牌子。

把板切开看，
里面全是细细的管子。
血从管子里流过。
这说明那些板
是活的，会流血。
pages.scene: One tall bony plate cut open on a cream background, showing many fine branching channels running through it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有人说，
板是用来散热的。
热血流进板里，
风一吹就凉下来，
像汽车前面的水箱。

也有人说，
板是用来吓唬人的。
血一涌上去，
板就变得通红，
看着大了一圈。

到底是哪一种呢？
也许两样都是。
一样东西
本来就可以
有好几个用处。
pages.scene: One stegosaurus standing in profile on a cream background with its plates flushed a warm red, one other dinosaur backing away from it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的尾巴尖上
还有四根长刺，
每根都有大人的胳膊那么长。
甩起来呼呼响，
谁都得躲开。
pages.scene: Close view of a stegosaurus tail tip on a cream background, four long sharp spikes spreading out from it, swinging, with motion lines behind. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
剑龙的头很小，
脑子只有核桃那么大。
可它在地球上
活了好几千万年，
看来脑子小也不耽误事。

它的脖子不长，
嘴巴几乎贴着地。
它吃的是矮矮的蕨叶，
不跟长脖子的
抢树顶那一层。
pages.scene: One stegosaurus lowering its head to eat low ferns on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
那排板
不是两边对齐的。
是左一块、右一块
错开着排，
看上去更宽更唬人。

我伸手
摸了摸那块板。
薄薄的，边上还有点糙。
它当年
真的会变红吗？
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up reaching out to touch one tall bony plate on a museum mount, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, thoughtful.
